name: Janss Marketplace
summary: Janss Marketplace is a well-established open-air shopping center in Thousand Oaks offering one-stop shopping, dining, and entertainment in a pleasant outdoor setting. With big-box stores, casual eateries, a splash fountain, and regular community events, it serves as both a convenient retail destination and a popular gathering place for families and friends.
demographics: Janss Marketplace serves the affluent Thousand Oaks community, attracting primarily middle to upper-middle-class families with household incomes above the California average. The trade area draws residents from Thousand Oaks and surrounding Conejo Valley communities, with a customer base that skews toward families with children, young professionals, and active retirees. Shoppers value the convenient one-stop shopping experience for everyday needs combined with casual dining options, reflecting the suburban lifestyle preferences of the area. The splash fountain and community events indicate a family-friendly orientation that appeals to households seeking both practical shopping and recreational gathering spaces.
description: Janss Marketplace stands as a beloved community shopping and entertainment destination in the heart of Thousand Oaks, California, strategically positioned at the corner of Moorpark Road and Hillcrest Drive. This open-air shopping center has established itself as a go-to location for residents seeking a pleasant outdoor shopping experience, featuring big-box retailers, casual dining establishments, and essential services all in one convenient location. The center's inviting atmosphere is enhanced by thoughtfully designed seating areas throughout the property, allowing visitors to relax and enjoy the Southern California weather. A popular splash fountain serves as a focal point for families, providing entertainment for children while parents shop or dine at the various eateries with outdoor seating options. Beyond everyday shopping, Janss Marketplace has become a true community gathering place, hosting special events that bring neighbors together and create lasting memories, making it more than just a shopping center but a vital part of the Thousand Oaks community fabric.
